grade.basis: Complete three-page score inspected, bars 1–18 and final cadence. Cello 1 sustains a high treble-clef cantus with ornaments; cellos 2–3 have continuous chromatic semiquaver figuration and shifts, cello 4 a simpler quaver bass. Cello 1 moves into treble clef/short thumb-position range, returns to bass; largely crotchet/quaver stepwise motion. Other parts remain bass clef and lower in range.
